title: ipns_publisher: IpnsPublisher struct and run loop
description: Create crates/transit/src/retention/ipns_publisher.rs. Struct: pub struct IpnsPublisher { ipfs: rust_ipfs::Ipfs, groups: BTreeMap<String, Cid> }. Method pub fn new(ipfs: rust_ipfs::Ipfs) -> Self. Method pub async fn run(mut self, mut rx: mpsc::Receiver<IpnsEvent>). IpnsEvent = struct { group: String, cid: Cid }. In run loop: recv event, update self.groups, call update_and_publish(). Method async fn update_and_publish(&mut self): 1. call build_index_json(&self.groups) to get JSON bytes; 2. call self.ipfs.put_block(block) or equivalent to store index; 3. call self.ipfs.publish_ipns(index_path) — log warn on error, do not panic; 4. log info with groups count and ipns path. pub fn build_index_json(groups: &BTreeMap<String, Cid>) -> Vec<u8>: serialize as UTF-8 JSON {"version":1,"groups":{"comp.lang.rust":"<cid>"}}, BTreeMap ordering ensures deterministic output. Add pub mod ipns_publisher to retention/mod.rs. Why: allows stable IPNS discovery of per-group article tips.
